body:
@matsko Just tested latest build and found it fixed the two cases I provided. Thanks for the quick turnaround!

**However**, I have found another case where the animation end styles are now too persistent. i.e. they stay even after setting a new state.

Repro: [https://plnkr.co/edit/fWaBeI?p=preview](https://plnkr.co/edit/fWaBeI?p=preview)  (uses master builds)

I expect the opacity to be 1 after the animation finishes. i.e. the 'normal' state

PS I can open a new issue if you want, but figured it was related to this issue

Actually, the `group()` end styles are overriding the last `animate(style())` in the plunker above. i.e. it is ignoring the order

```typescript
trigger('transAnim', [
   state('normal', style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)', opacity: '1' })),
   state('intrans', style({ transform: 'translate3d(90px, 0px,0)', opacity: '0' })),
   transition('normal => intrans',
     [
       style({ opacity: '1' }),
       group([
         animate('1000ms 200ms', keyframes([
           style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)', offset: 0.25 }),
           style({ color: '#ffffff', offset: 0.7 }),
           style({ transform: 'translate3d(90px, 0px,0)', offset: 1 }),
         ])),
         animate('500ms 1100ms ease-in-out', style({ opacity: '0', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 191, 255, 0.5)' }))
       ]),
       style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)' }),
       animate('500ms 50ms ease-in-out', style({ opacity: '1' })),
     ])
 ])
```
Also, I seem to be changing the state back to 'normal' before the 'intrans' animation is complete. I'd expect it to still apply the 'normal' styles.

/cc @matsko
@dharders thank you for reporting the new bug. Please do make an issue for this and I'll hop onto it first thing tomorrow.

**Current behavior**

Follow up to #16919

Using the latest master builds, with PR #16937 merged, some animation end styles are now too persistent. i.e. they stay even after setting a new state or the wrong style is persisted.

Last working version was 4.2.0-beta.1.  (PR #16937 addressed reported issues in #16919 of 4.2.0-rc.0, but this issue slipped through)

**Expected behavior**
<!-- Describe what the behavior would be without the bug. -->
Expect the **last** style in the `transition([])` to be persisted if outside of a parallel `group()`. Also, if a state change occurs 'in-flight' of another animation, I expect the new state styles (and or animation) to be applied.

**Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions**
<!--
If the current behavior is a bug or you can illustrate your feature request better with an example, 
please provide the *STEPS TO REPRODUCE* and if possible a *MINIMAL DEMO* of the problem via

-->
Repro: https://plnkr.co/edit/fWaBeI?p=preview  (uses master builds)

I expect the opacity to be 1 after the animation finishes. i.e. the 'normal' state

The `group()` end styles are overriding the last `animate(style())` in the plunker above. i.e. it seems to be ignoring the order

```typescript
trigger('transAnim', [
   state('normal', style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)', opacity: '1' })),
   state('intrans', style({ transform: 'translate3d(90px, 0px,0)', opacity: '0' })),
   transition('normal => intrans',
     [
       style({ opacity: '1' }),
       group([
         animate('1000ms 200ms', keyframes([
           style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)', offset: 0.25 }),
           style({ color: '#ffffff', offset: 0.7 }),
           style({ transform: 'translate3d(90px, 0px,0)', offset: 1 }),
         ])),
         animate('500ms 1100ms ease-in-out', style({ opacity: '0' }))
       ]),
       style({ transform: 'translate3d(0px, 0px,0)' }),
       animate('500ms 50ms ease-in-out', style({ opacity: '1' })),
     ])
 ])
```
Also, changing the state back to 'normal' before the 'intrans' animation is complete, I'd still expect it to apply the 'normal' styles.

**What is the motivation / use case for changing the behavior?**
<!-- Describe the motivation or the concrete use case -->
Fix animation end styling. Behave as it did in v4.2.0-beta.1

You can set the plunker ng version in `systemjs.config.js` back to 4.2.0-beta.1 to see the desired behaviour.

Don't forget to set ngNightly = false;

